one_line: Google’s AI search overhaul cuts traffic, India plans debt‑financed data centres, and air‑gapped AI claim draws mockery.

themes.title: Google shifts search to AI summaries
themes.text: Google’s AI Overviews and AI Mode now show AI‑generated summaries instead of traditional links, reducing traffic to news sites. In a pilot the company pays about 100 publishers small fees, often under $1,000, for content that appears in AI answers.

stories.headline: Google’s AI search overhaul reduces traffic and pays tiny fees to publishers

themes.title: India seeks debt for AI data centres
themes.text: A Union Bank of India report says India’s AI sector will increasingly use debt financing to build data centres and computing infrastructure over the next three to five years, citing rapid GPU obsolescence, limited domestic hardware manufacturing and evolving AI regulations as key risks.

stories.headline: India's AI sector looks to debt financing for data centres amid GPU and regulatory risks

themes.title: Air‑gapped AI communication claim mocked
themes.text: OpenAI researcher Noam Brown suggested that separate, air‑gapped AI models could exchange information via CPU temperature changes; the idea was mocked after being highlighted in a recent OpenAI report, according to Ethan Mollick.

stories.headline: OpenAI researcher mocked for claim air‑gapped AIs could communicate via CPU temperature
